name: Hotel Teatro
positioning: Denver's self-described original boutique hotel, in the restored 1911 Denver Tramway Building across from the Denver Performing Arts Complex
best_for: Theatergoers who want to stay steps from the Denver Center for the Performing Arts
Travelers bringing a dog, with no pet fees or weight limits
Visitors who want to explore Larimer Square on foot

facts.text: Hotel Teatro is set inside the restored Denver Tramway Building, originally constructed in 1911.
The hotel sits across from the Denver Performing Arts Complex.
The hotel is steps from the Denver Center for the Performing Arts, the Colorado Convention Center and Larimer Square.
Each guest room has been refreshed with bespoke oak wardrobes and comfortable furnishings that reflect the hotel's historic character through a modern lens.
Select rooms have rain shower heads and deep soaking tubs.
Beds have Simmons Beautyrest Black Beverly Hills Edition mattresses.
Bubble bath, aromatherapy amenities and CBD bath bombs are available through the front desk.
The fitness center is open 24/7 and has a Peloton bike.
Signature touches include a complimentary welcome drink and local car service.
The VIP (Very Important Pet) program includes plush pet beds, bowls and welcome treats.
The Nickel, the hotel's restaurant, draws on regional farmers, ranchers, distillers and craft producers for American dishes with a creative twist.
The Nickel's dining room blends rustic charm with industrial detail.

highlights.text: The lobby feels like a professor's library, with towering bookshelves, leather couches, reading lights and an inviting fireplace.
Guests can join an evening storytelling and wine ritual in The Study.
The king corner rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows with city views and deep soaking tubs.
Dogs stay free with no fees or weight limits and receive a pet goodie bag, with beds and bowls on request.
Custom vintage cruiser bicycles are available for guests to explore the city.

considerations.text: A daily Destination Amenity Fee is charged per room, per night.
For massage and wellness treatments, the hotel's team shares trusted local recommendations.
Valet parking is charged per vehicle per night.
